title: Technician II Integrated Simulation Evidence Record
description: An integrated evidence record for the Technician II simulation lab, linking scenario observations, data verification, differential reasoning, authorized actions, escalation, handoff, and reflective follow-up.
instructions: Create one row for each meaningful decision point in the simulation.
Identify the evidence available at that moment before recording the decision or action.
Record the authority boundary and escalation path whenever the scenario exceeds the technician role.
Use the final rows to document handoff quality, verification of outcomes, and what evidence would improve a future response.
limitations: This worksheet documents learner reasoning and evidence; it is not itself a credential decision or assessor score sheet.
Simulation authorization does not grant permission to perform restricted real-world tasks.
